newsitem.title: FINLAND: Weak Helsinki ends near lows as dollar tumbles.
newsitem.headline: Weak Helsinki ends near lows as dollar tumbles.

text.p: With Finnish media chasing an elusive bull it was the bears' turn to picnic in the share market on Friday, the indices ending clearly lower as German rate-hike talk again hit the dollar and treasuries fell.

The FOX derivatives and portfolio benchmark slid 2.11 percent to 1,204 -- its sharpest drop in almost a month -- and the HEX general index shed 2.12 percent to 3,500. On the week, the FOX fell 2.40 percent. Volume was thin: 521 million markka.
Trade was subdued by the holiday season and the direction dictated by choppy international markets -- brokers saw no internal or fundamental drivers for Helsinki's weakness.
Nokia led decliners, shedding 9.50 markka to 454.50 on the back of the dollar's weakness, and making up about 38 percent of total volume.

But forestries were also out of favour, UPM-Kymmene generating quite heavy volume on the fall after its H1 report on Thursday did not yield the extra surprise some had anticipated: it ended down 3.40 markka at 136.50.
Merita also spent most of the session in negative ground and with volume fairly heavy, but put in a late uptick to end at 23.10 markka, up 0.10.
